title: Daytime bookshelf leaves light system-bar icons unreadable on a light background
symptom: The initial real bookshelf capture during the visual upgrade shows white status-bar icons against the light page background; the time is effectively invisible.
root_cause: BookshelfScreen renders the Material theme background but does not set system-bar colors or icon appearance. The Activity uses transparent system bars, and the existing explicit appearance management belongs only to ReaderScreen. A light bookshelf therefore does not establish the dark icons it needs.
fix: BookshelfScreen now applies a local SideEffect using MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background for both system bars and the background luminance to choose dark or light icons. Navigation-bar contrast enforcement is disabled on Android Q and later so the explicitly chosen appearance remains coordinated.

The effect skips previews and safely unwraps the view context to an Activity. It runs only while the bookshelf is composed; no global theme effect is added, and ReaderScreen retains its own system-bar ownership.
evidence: The pre-fix normal day-mode bookshelf screenshot directly exposed the unreadable time and icons; the missing bookshelf system-bar setup was confirmed in source.

On the final debug APK with SHA256 prefix 901173, actual emulator day and night captures show readable time and status icons, with coordinated navigation bars. Saved images: docs/superpowers/specs/assets/2026-09-20-visual-direction/implemented-bookshelf.png and implemented-bookshelf-night.png.

The same final-build device check confirms that opening the reader lets its existing system-bar styling take over normally. These observations cover the checked emulator day/night and page transition, not every device skin.
impact: The covered bookshelf themes now keep the system time and icons readable without overriding reading-page appearance or changing reading layout, settings, or playback.
